title: 第25章 云和夫人 妾身看上你了第26章 条件太阴鬼石到手
content_zh:
天心宗。
一块破碎的玉牌。
里面没了任何气息，那一道灵魂，也破碎了。
一个男人阴冷盯着玉牌，双手捧着，舍不得放下。
眼眸内，藏着无限的杀意，随时都会爆发。
前面，跪着一个弟子，瑟瑟发抖。
“什么时候发现的？”
“今天早上。”
“咕噜。”
那弟子哽咽一口，不敢乱动。
他低着头，一点也不敢抬头看那人的面孔，生怕被杀了。
“可知道是谁杀的？”
那弟子木讷摇头，不知道其中的奥秘，他有些茫然。
“砰。”
弟子飞了出去。
大殿的门户关上，那弟子赶紧爬起来，顾不上重伤的身躯，赶紧跑。
大殿，陷入了安静。
冰冷的男人捏碎了玉牌，整个人有些疯狂。
好一会儿，才冷静下来。
“明兰，为师不会让你白死的。”

“白云派，本座要看看到底是谁杀了你，这笔账，绝对不能算了。”
“敢杀害我天心宗弟子，白云派，哼。”
挥手。
一个人影落在他的面前。
“白云派的卧底还剩下多少？”
“启禀大人，明兰死了之后，就剩下两个。”
黑衣人冰冷回答：“明兰是在接触了许君白之后，死了。”
“之前那些卧底都在接触他之后，莫名其妙被找出来，然后，有的被白云派策反，有的呢，直接死了。”
“基本上，白云派的卧底都被找得七七八八，我等的安排，似乎要失败了。”
白云派手段高明，竟然能够策反他们的人。
空明真人瞳孔凝缩，眼眉低垂。
“策反的弟子死了吗？”
“启禀大人，都杀了。”
“许君白呢。”
“……”
大殿内，再次陷入了安静。
content_en:
Tianxin Sect.
A broken jade tablet.
There was no breath inside, and the soul was broken.
A man stared at the jade plaque coldly, holding it in both hands, reluctant to put it down.
There is infinite murderous intent hidden in his eyes, which can explode at any time.
In front, a disciple was kneeling, shivering.
"When did you find out?"
"This morning."
"Gulu."
The disciple choked up and didn't dare to move.
He lowered his head, not daring to look up at the man's face for fear of being killed.
"Do you know who killed him?"
The disciple shook his head dullly, not knowing the mystery, and he was a little confused.
"Bang."
The disciple flew out.
The door of the main hall was closed, and the disciple quickly got up, ignoring his seriously injured body, and ran away.
The main hall fell into silence.
The cold man crushed the jade token and looked a little crazy.
It took a while to calm down.
"Minglan, I won't let your death be in vain as a teacher."
"Baiyun Sect, I want to find out who killed you. This debt must not be settled."
"Dare to kill my Tianxin Sect disciple, the Baiyun Sect, huh."
Wave.
A figure fell in front of him.
"How many undercover agents of the Baiyun Sect are left?"
"Master Qi, after Minglan's death, there are only two left."
The man in black replied coldly: "Minglan died after coming into contact with Xu Junbai."
"Those undercover agents were found out of nowhere after coming into contact with him. Then, some were instigated by the Baiyun faction to rebel, and some died directly."
"Basically, all the undercover agents of the Baiyun Sect have been found. It seems that our arrangement is going to fail."
The Baiyun faction was so clever that they were able to instigate people to rebel against them.
Master Kong Ming's pupils were condensed and his eyebrows were lowered.
"Is the disciple who instigated rebellion dead?"
"Lord Qizhen, kill them all."
"Where is Xu Junbai."
"..."
In the main hall, silence fell again.
